analysis:
Integration pass over the three per-unit analyses plus the replayed CHANGELOG.md, docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md, ClusterSetupWizardStore.swift (head ~126-134, new optional stopsAsked) and ProviderCore.swift (version 0.10.13). I found no concrete security regression in the supplied evidence.

(1) The cluster stop counter (stopsAsked/stopsBefore) travels on the owner-only paired-Mac control channel. A peer that can send there already controls stop and serve, so a forged or inflated count can at most end an onboarding wait or suppress a serve. That is a limited availability effect (A-018), and a nil count from an older build fails toward following the start. It does not touch TB-002, TB-011, A-001 or the key custody and attestation paths.

(2) The Gemma 4 loop-exit-thinking continuation is bounded: 8,192-token cap, skipped below 256 tokens, 5 s slot-release wait, same cache scope and sampling (so T-041 account scoping is unchanged in kind), and not used with logprobs or on a pair. Output goes through the existing encrypted response path (T-008). Docs say cancel is honored (T-010). The new env passthrough keys (DARKBLOOM_LOOP_GUARD, DARKBLOOM_LOOP_EXIT_THINKING) are inference tuning toggles in the operator's own environment (ADV-001 already controls it), and the App Attest worker allowlist is unchanged.

Open contracts for the next review (not findings; 281 replay units omitted and the Swift implementations are not supplied):
- Whether the continuation preserves the original cacheSalt/cacheScope.
- Whether exit-thinking is skipped for token-constrained, forced-tool and JSON-format requests, since the submission appears to omit tokenConstraint.
- Billing and usage accounting of the continuation row.
- Whether the control channel authenticates senders before stopsBefore is honored.
- Whether the test-only hooks are excluded from release builds.
- Whether the loop-guard exit-thinking log line stays content-free.
- The changelog's claim that registration fields and MLX pins are unchanged (A-017/T-054) is unverified.

No threat-model update is required from the visible changes.
